rv.q: Alan Strachan ’s cleverly orchestrated revival of his second big hit, first seen in Scarborough in 1969, reminds us just what a comic master Ayckbourn is.

But the performances are bright, with Le Prevost’s Frank delightfully hapless and Tamzin Outhwaite on song as gutsy, hot-blooded Teresa. Though there’s not much sign of the love promised in the title, Ayckbourn does have a few sharp things to say about social class, unequal relationships and men’s insensitivity.
